subject: Re: Setup checklist
text: Hi. This is the follow up from Tuesday. Please bring the banner, attendance sheet, and cash box. The club needs them before the open house. I have a dental appointment that overlaps with the setup time. It runs from four until five fifteen. You will need to arrive early. Check that the table has the green runner. Test the projector when you enter. The extension cord is in the cabinet. Do not accept donations after seven. The hall closes exactly at eight. If the door access code fails, call the maintenance line. Confirm you received this, or send me a text note.
